instruction: A cinematic medium close-up still of a contemporary dance performance on a dark stage. On the left, the woman in the yellow shirt (R2) reaches upward, head tilted back looking straight up. In the center, the man in the rust shirt (R3) arches his arm overhead, looking up and slightly right. On the right, the woman in the yellow shirt (R4) looks toward the upper right with arms raised. The dancers are huddled closely, their hands reaching high. In the background, multiple bystander arms are raised. Soft overhead lighting highlights the warm yellow and rust tones against the dark grey backdrop.
